cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.22)
project(stellar_udfread C)
set(UDFREAD_VERSION_MAJOR 1)
set(UDFREAD_VERSION_MINOR 2)
set(UDFREAD_VERSION_MICRO 0)
file(MAKE_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/udfread)
configure_file(src/udfread.h ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/udfread/udfread.h COPYONLY)
configure_file(src/blockinput.h ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/udfread/blockinput.h COPYONLY)
configure_file(src/udfread-version.h.in ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/udfread/udfread-version.h @ONLY)
add_library(udfread STATIC src/default_blockinput.c src/ecma167.c src/udfread.c src/udfread-version.c)
set_target_properties(udfread PROPERTIES POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON C_VISIBILITY_PRESET hidden)
target_include_directories(udfread PUBLIC ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR} PRIVATE src ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/udfread)
target_compile_definitions(udfread PRIVATE HAVE_UNISTD_H=1 HAVE_FCNTL_H=1 HAVE_PTHREAD_H=1 HAVE_UDFREAD_VERSION_H=1 _POSIX_C_SOURCE=200809L)
